---
title: "Shared academy assets"
---

Cross-course, reusable assets and Quarto includes. Anything under `shared/`
can be referenced from the root academy site and from every course website.

## Layout

```
shared/
  css/         # Cross-course stylesheets (academy.css)
  images/      # Cross-course images (logos, diagrams)
  icons/       # Icon assets
  javascript/  # Cross-course JS snippets
  includes/    # Reusable Quarto include snippets
```

## Includes

Include snippets under `shared/includes/` are meant to be pulled into pages
with Quarto's include shortcode, for example:

```
{{{< include ../../shared/includes/prerequisites.qmd >}}}
```

Available includes:

- `objectives.qmd` — learning objectives callout
- `prerequisites.qmd` — prerequisites callout
- `tryit.qmd` — "try it yourself" callout
- `references.qmd` — further-reading callout
- `warning.qmd` — heads-up warning callout

## Styling

`css/academy.css` holds the small set of cross-course styles. Courses may
extend it via their own `format.html.css` entries but should not duplicate
what is already defined here.
